definitions.explanation: Pleasantly warm; describing freshly cooked food or warm feelings.

examples.japanese: ほかほかの⟦{焼|や}きたて→焼き立て：08344_yakitate⟧⟦パン→パン：00553_pan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べた→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: I ate freshly baked, warm bread.

examples.japanese: ⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ほかほかしてきた。
examples.english: My body started to feel warm.

examples.japanese: ほかほかの⟦{御飯|ごはん}→御飯：00776_gohan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{食|た}べたい→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: I want to eat steaming hot rice.

notes:
ほかほか is an onomatopoeia describing pleasant warmth, especially from freshly cooked food.

GRAMMAR:
- Adverb: ほかほかと⟦{温|あたた}かい→温かい：13395_atatakai⟧
- Na-adjective: ほかほかの + noun
- Suru verb: ⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ほかほかする

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ほかほかの⟦{御飯|ごはん}→御飯：00776_gohan⟧: steaming hot rice
- ほかほかの⟦{弁当|べんとう}→弁当：01014_bentou⟧: hot/warm bento
- ほかほかに⟦{温|あたた}まる→温まる：02095_atatamaru⟧: to get nice and warm

NUANCE:
Conveys pleasant, comforting warmth - not scorching hot. Associated with freshly cooked food, warm drinks, or the comfortable feeling after a bath.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦あつあつ→あつあつ：20109_atsuatsu⟧: piping hot (hotter than ほかほか)
- ⟦ぽかぽか→ぽかぽか：05784_pokapoka⟧: warm and cozy (body warmth)

CULTURAL NOTE:
ほっかほっか{亭|てい} is a popular bento chain whose name derives from this word.
